title: Quinlan Vos
description: Quinlan Vos was a Jedi Master during the Clone Wars. The Jedi Council tasked Vos with eliminating Count Dooku. During the effort to get close to Dooku, Vos fell in love with Dooku's apprentice, Asajj Ventress. Vos was in danger of falling to the dark side, but Ventress, reciprocated Vos's love, sacrificed herself to save him.
